title: Mini profile
one_line: Tap anyone anywhere: avatar, level, win rate, ADD FRIEND.
opens_from: match-hud (tap a player card, if enabled)

anatomy.spec: 84 pt straddling the top edge, ring by frame tier.
Name, level, win rate as three compact stats.
ADD FRIEND (info blue) if not friends; REMOVE FRIEND (neutral, through confirm-dialog) if already friends; nothing if it is the player's own row.

motion: Standard popup open/close, fast (160 ms) - this is a quick glance, not a destination.
data: StatsService for the numbers, friend status from the friends backend once T-C1 ships.
do_not: Do not show a full profile's worth of detail here - three stats maximum, this is a glance not a destination.
Do not let ADD FRIEND fire twice - show 'Request sent' immediately.
acceptance: Opens from a rank row and a friend row.
All four states in 'states' are reachable.
steps: 2. Build the small-card chassis with the avatar straddling the top.
3. Wire the three states of the action button.
4. Wire entry points from rankings and friends.
